description: List the organization's branded rate-email campaigns (name, criteria, cadence, status, last run).
name: list_email_campaigns

campaigns.description: The campaigns visible to the API key making the call. Empty when the org has none; the MCP layer wraps the upstream array so the result is always an object.

items.description: A branded email campaign, with its products, recipients and send state.

count.description: Number of items in the array above. There is no pagination on this route — this is the complete set for the org, not a page.
